caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, metal object resembling a vintage toaster or grill, supported by four short, outward-curving legs. The top of the object features parallel metal bars forming an open grate, with six circular knobs, one located near each corner along the top edge. The main body has a dark grey metallic color with multiple small, evenly spaced round holes on its sides. Attached to one side is a wooden cylindrical handle, which is brown and smooth, projecting out horizontally. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the metallic and wooden elements of the object. The artist's signature, "FRANK MCSHETEE," appears at the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Toaster or Broiler
